top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a predicted invariant (Z2 topological insulators, quantum spin Hall state) and its decisive observation in HgTe quantum wells, with about two decades of independent confirmation by transport, ARPES and STM. The citation is scoped to the two-dimensional step and the three names, and it is distinct from 2016, which honoured topological phase transitions in model systems. Credit is not perfectly clean (Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang on the HgTe proposal; Hasan on 3D), but the narrowed citation states this limit. P002 has a cleaner attribution boundary and is mature, but I cannot verify magic-wavelength priority against other lattice-clock groups from the supplied material, so it ranks second. No award is last since both proposals describe real, mature discoveries.
